extracted.intended_audience: IP statisticians, policymakers, IP office staff, researchers and analysts working with intellectual property statistics
extracted.subtask_description: WIPO statistical indicators and procedural metrics for industrial designs (and related plant variety filing statistics) used to measure design activity, office performance, and cross‑jurisdictional comparisons. Includes counts, rates, pendency, examiner staffing and caveats on comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of application design counts by sector for top origins
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of application design counts by the top three sectors for the top 10 origins, expressed as percentages (e.g., Advertising, ICT and audiovisual, Transport, Construction, Textiles and accessories, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A concordance table produced by OECD was used to convert the 32 classes into 12 industry sectors (see annex C for definitions). These figures are based on data from 118 IP offices. Data for several of the larger offices are either not available or incomplete, including for the offices of Japan and the US. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resident application design count per USD 100 billion of GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design count per USD 100 billion of GDP for the top 20 origins, reported for 2011 and 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GDP data are in constant 2017 US PPP dollars. Origins were selected based on the top origins list in terms of application design count and on GDP data availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resident application design count per million population
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design count per million population for the top 20 origins, reported for 2011 and 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Origins were selected based on the top origins list in terms of application design count and on population data availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trend in industrial design registrations in force worldwide
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of the number of industrial design registrations in force worldwide (2011–2021) with annual growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO estimates cover 129 IP offices and include direct national and regional applications, as well as designations received via the Hague System. Data refer to the number of industrial design registrations in force and not the number of designs contained in registrations in force. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design registrations in force for the top offices (counts and growth rates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of industrial design registrations in force for the top 20 offices in 2021, with per‑office growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Data refer to the number of industrial design registrations in force and not the number of designs contained in registrations in force. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial design registrations in force as percentage of total registrations by registration year
rubrics_metrics.description: For each registration year t, the percentage of industrial designs registered in year t that remained in force in 2021 (trend by registration year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages are calculated using the number of industrial designs registered in year t and in force in 2021 divided by the total number of industrial designs registered in year t. The graph is based on data from the 92 offices (including most of the larger offices) for which a breakdown by year of registration was available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average age of industrial design registrations in force
rubrics_metrics.description: Average age (in years) of industrial design registrations in force at selected offices (comparisons given for 2016 and 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metric reported by selected offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of industrial design examination outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Share (percent) distribution of examination outcomes at selected offices for 2021: Registered, Rejected, Withdrawn/abandoned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data from IP offices using a common questionnaire and methodology. However, due to differences in industrial design procedures between offices, data cannot be fully harmonized. Therefore, caution should be exercised when making comparisons across offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potentially pending applications (by office)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of potentially pending industrial design applications for selected offices in 2021 (raw counts per office).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data from IP offices using a common questionnaire and methodology. Because of procedural differences, caution is advised when comparing counts across offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average pendency times: first office action and final decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of days from filing date to first office action and from filing date to final decision for selected offices, 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data using a common questionnaire and methodology but procedural differences make full harmonization difficult; exercise caution in cross‑office comparisons. Note: for some offices data refer to formalities examinations only (see footnotes). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of industrial design examiners (FTE) per office
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of industrial design examiners (full‑time equivalent) reported for selected offices in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FTE = full time equivalent. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications processed / Registered / Rejected / Withdrawn / Pending (office procedural counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per‑office counts of total applications processed, applications registered, applications rejected, withdrawn/abandoned, and applications pending (procedural workload metrics for 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects procedural data using a common questionnaire and methodology. The total number of applications processed for any given office may be incomplete due to omission of one or several elements by the office. Data may also reflect formalities examinations only for some offices (footnote). Exercise caution when comparing across offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application design counts by office and origin (resident vs non‑resident) and year‑on‑year changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Tabulated application design counts by office and by origin (resident/non‑resident), total counts, equivalent application design counts by origin, and change over the previous year (2021 table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (a) Design count by origin data are incomplete, because some offices do not report the origin of applications. (b) Only Hague designation data are available and/or this office has not reported the origin of applications therefore the design count by office and origin data may be incomplete. (c) OAPI is the competent office for processing applications. n.a. = not applicable; .. = not available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration design counts by office and origin, equivalent registration counts and registrations in force
rubrics_metrics.description: Tabulated registration design counts by office and origin (resident/non‑resident), equivalent registration design counts by origin, and the number of registrations in force and change over previous year (2021 table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same data caveats as application counts: some offices do not report origin, Hague‑only data, OAPI note, n.a./.. conventions. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant variety application time series and top destinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of plant variety applications worldwide (2007–2021), top receiving jurisdictions in 2021 (counts and resident vs non‑resident breakdown), and regional shares (2011 vs 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights include growth rates (e.g., Applications grew by +12% in 2021) and notes on which offices contributed most to growth (China, US, UK). The CPVO/UK changes following Brexit are discussed as context for shifts in resident/non‑resident classification. Source: WIPO Statistics Database (Figure references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional and jurisdictional shares and resident/non‑resident composition (plant varieties)
rubrics_metrics.description: Share metrics showing geographic distribution of plant variety filings by region (e.g., Asia, Europe, North America, LAC, Africa, Oceania) and top offices' resident vs non‑resident composition (e.g., China's resident share 94.1%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpretation includes notes on drivers of changes (resident filings vs non‑resident filings) and administrative impacts (e.g., UK no longer a CPVO member). Source: WIPO Statistics Database and figure references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data comparability and reporting caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: Caveats about data collection and harmonization: WIPO collects data using common questionnaires and methodology but procedural differences across offices mean data cannot be fully harmonized; some offices have incomplete reporting; footnotes explain n.a. and .. conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit recommendation: caution should be exercised when making comparisons across offices. Specific notes point to missing or incomplete data for some large offices and to cases where only Hague designation data are available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.
